effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[All Turns] When this Digimon suspends, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] All of your suspended Digimon get +1000 DP.
